thesis: identity of e, i, pi in Euler identity under IDCM operator reading
verdict: i = lattice operator U_{N_d} (ord 4 = B); -1 = half-circuit U_{2N_d} (double cover, s=1/2); pi = radian unit (22/7 substitution invisible below all observational sigma); e = log chart (0 occurrences in predictions)
